in_chain_replicate.role: the within-chain null the delta is read at

boundary: A development read on a TRAIN construction fold (owner decisions 28 and 86); never a test claim, never a generalisation claim, and it admits nothing by itself.
reported_beside_every_verdict: the per-scenario table in both the natural-mixture and the equal-stratum weighting
the frontier row: effect x prefilled tokens per row x GPU hours per 1,080 rows
the measured token delta of the Perception block, against the read's +1.4 tokens per row

the DELIVERY CHECK: on how many rows did the flown arm actually deliver the row's own gold intent boundary entry, and does that agree with the offline replication's prediction? A delta with a delivery rate the replication did not predict is an engineering defect, not an effect

the CONVERSION, finally measured: of the rows that newly received their gold intent's boundary entry, how many answered the intent correctly. This is the number the registration could not know, and it is the cell's most valuable output whatever the verdict
the per-class table over the bad-case bank's INTENT-UNCOVERED and INTENT-COVERED rows
